description: What scripts/gen-rules-index.py reads from text.md: each rule's line, the roles it binds, its rule ids and its evidence, in the text's order; the rule ids of its tables, each with the roles its row binds; and the lines of unreadable.md whose rule names no role, which the script refuses. text.md holds a rule of each reading: a static section (§1), a subject (line 19), a pronoun after it, a passive's agent (22), two roles and a lead-in's list (24), a pronoun in a nested item and a continuation's evidence (30, 32), a MAY's subject before a pronoun (36), role labels in a table row (40), a section's id (45), a lint code (50) and a section's title (55). Its §0 and its header state keywords that are no rule.
